Patna students protest exam irregularities, clash with police

Students protesting alleged irregularities in the Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) and Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) exams clashed with police in Patna. The students were marching towards the Chief Minister's residence. The protests centered on demands related to the BPSC 70th exam. The specific nature of the alleged irregularities and the outcome of the clashes were not detailed in the provided coverage.
